baseline_calibration: Cosine scores multiplied by fixed 20; all baseline score vectors use the same existing temperature grid, calibration labels only.
baselines: BM25 over successful training replay instructions, max document score per procedure
cosine nearest successful training example (one nearest neighbor)
cosine normalized training centroid per procedure
boundary: Artificial manually authored distribution; selects four existing programs. No program synthesis, action permission, general procedure reliability or live Agentd claim.

contracts.goal: Keep the last input occurrence of each id; emit records sorted by id.
contracts.output: JSON list of complete records, one per id

contracts.goal: Sum every score for each group; emit group and total rows sorted by group.
Keep records with score >= threshold, preserving input order and duplicates.
contracts.output: JSON list of complete qualifying records

contracts.goal: Keep all records and sort by ascending score, preserving input order on ties.
contracts.output: JSON list of all complete input records

costs: Charge failed selected executions; report all oracle replay attempts separately, shared actual Encoder work, selector time, Head calls and retained bytes; no equal-cost claim.

execution_environment.filesystem: fresh private temporary directory per attempted fixed procedure
execution_environment.success_criterion: independent reread, unchanged input and exact canonical output bytes

improvement_rule: All three Head seeds must exceed both feature baselines and BM25 on heldout forced success; report per-input-family and per-template-family paired uncertainty.
label_visibility: All split labels are generated by the observer before training and are available to the evaluation harness. This is not a blind test. Heldout labels are excluded from selectors, SGD, temperature fitting and seed selection.
labels: Unique successful candidate from all four actual executions; fail the run on ambiguity.
primary: Heldout independently observed output-file success, forced top-1, one execution per query/arm/policy.
secondary: Confidence>=0.7 selective policy; abstention has zero executions and zero success. This is a separate real execution set, so forced plus selective may execute twice per query/arm; both sets and all phase attempts are charged.
selection_input: Only public query text; no goal, labels, output bytes or input-file family routing.

training.calibration: Temperature only on calibration; no heldout passed to trainer.
training.dev: Development metrics are monitored, never select hyperparameters or seed.

withdrawal: Research host checks learning ancestors and current feature source-record digests before and after actual forward; a failed view permanently invalidates that owner instance. New instances still trust the supplied host frontier, not a durable authenticated ledger. This is not production admission or parameter unlearning.
